item.description:
### Fixed - The FILES section no longer leaves an empty strip at the bottom of the window, and the file tree no longer snaps upward when a window resize ends. - Git failures now show a short human-readable message instead of a raw technical error dump.
### Changed - CHANGES rows now use the same per-type file icons as the FILES tree. - The "↓0 ↑0" sync indicator is hidden when there is nothing to pull or push, and no longer appears in the CHANGES header. - Tidier section headers: unified icon sizes, typography and alignment across sections.
